links.outcome: Prediction error of DeepSeek-R1 vs Barrett Universal II formula against measured postoperative refraction
links.effect: Barrett MedAE 0.36 D and MAE 0.43 D vs DeepSeek-R1 MedAE 0.76 D and MAE 0.77 D; Barrett better (Wilcoxon p<0.0001); within ±0.50 D 71.7% vs 25.9%.
links.quote: The paired comparison of per-eye absolute errors favored Barrett (Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p < 0.0001).

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark evaluating the clinical accuracy and safety of off-the-shelf DeepSeek-R1 against established formulas for IOL power calculation in cataract surgery.
